executive_summary: 3 findings across 1 hosts (3 critical by CVSS band); 1 are listed in the CISA KEV catalog. Findings are ranked by fuzzy priority using each asset's simulated exposure and criticality. Top 3 by priority: CVE-2022-22965 on Customer portal (Spring WebMVC, Java) (172.30.0.18:8080, priority 88.3 urgent); CVE-2016-1000027 on Customer portal (Spring WebMVC, Java) (172.30.0.18:8080, priority 77.4 urgent); CVE-2023-44794 on Customer portal (Spring WebMVC, Java) (172.30.0.18:8080, priority 65.6 high). Scenario: Simulated ACME Retail environment: public website, online shop, customer portal and public API are internet-facing; the corporate CMS, a partner portal and a staging app sit in the DMZ; CI, logging, search and file sharing are internal only. In reality all containers are isolated on a local Docker network without internet access.

findings.title: Spring Framework RCE - SpringShell
findings.evidence: lab-host-18:8080/tcp running Spring WebMVC/Framework 5.3.17 on JDK 9+
findings.label: urgent

fired_rules.text: IF cvss is critical AND epss is high THEN priority is urgent
IF criticality is high AND epss is high THEN priority is urgent
IF cvss is critical AND exposure is internet THEN priority is urgent

findings.attack_technique: T1059 (Command and Scripting Interpreter) / T1190 (Exploit Public-Facing Application)
findings.remediation: Upgrade Spring Framework to versions 5.3.18+, 5.2.20+, or apply official patches/workarounds (such as upgrading Spring Boot to 2.6.6+ or 2.5.12+). Sources: MITRE CWE (CWE-94 Improper Control of Generation of Code).

findings.title: Pivotal Spring Framework RCE
findings.label: urgent

fired_rules.text: IF cvss is critical AND exposure is internet THEN priority is urgent
IF cvss is critical AND epss is medium THEN priority is high

findings.remediation: Upgrade Spring Framework to patched versions addressing remote code execution vulnerabilities in data binding/deserialization. Ensure strict allowlisting of deserialized classes. Sources: MITRE CWE (CWE-502 Deserialization of Untrusted Data), OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG-INJT-22 Insecure Deserialization).

findings.title: Dromara Sa-Token Privilege Escalation
findings.evidence: lab-host-18:8080/tcp exposed service with potential Dromara Sa-Token library integration
findings.label: high

fired_rules.text: IF cvss is critical AND exposure is internet THEN priority is urgent
IF cvss is critical AND epss is low THEN priority is medium

findings.remediation: Upgrade Dromara Sa-Token to version 1.36.1 or later where the privilege escalation flaw is resolved. Manage trust zones and explicit authorization controls carefully. Sources: MITRE CWE (CWE-284 Improper Access Control).
